title: Entity facts record with scheduled good-standing verification

owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)
residual_risks: State registry data can lag filings.

title: Decision records for material governance and risk decisions
objective: Record each material decision (policy adoption, risk acceptance, exception, customer commitment) with owner, alternatives, evidence, rationale and review date, attributed to a human approver.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)
notes: Praxis decision record tooling exists; it is not yet used as the company's governance decision log.

title: Successor authority and break-glass credential custody
objective: Ensure a designated person can lawfully act for the company and reach critical accounts and keys if the principal is unavailable, with custody access logged and tested annually.
implementing_systems: Sealed credential custody (provider not yet assigned)
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)
residual_risks: Test may not reveal tacit-knowledge gaps

title: Policy-as-data with enforcement mapping gate
